summary: John's 10th-great-grandfather, of Sagg (Sagaponack); gravestone at Bridgehampton.
bio: Capt. Elnathan Topping of Sagg (1640–1705); recorded children 1664–1682; gravestone at Bridgehampton. In 1686 his father deeded Southampton lands to sons Elnathan and James. The Toppings lived at Sagg (Sagaponack) and Bridgehampton.
